QuestInfo.name: Orbis Cloud Piece
QuestInfo.0: Someone said Pixies in #m200000000# sometimes give up mysterious Cloud Pieces. Take it to Kylan.
QuestInfo.1: Obtain a #t04033354# from Pixies at Cloud Park in #m200000000# and take it to #p3000003# at #m400000001#. The #t04033354# can be obtained from #o4230106#, #o3230200#, and #o5120000#.
QuestInfo.2: This might help you understand Maple World a bit better.
